# MedShield

> Maritime medical case management for crew operators. MedShield manages the
> whole crew medical case - from the first call at sea to the closed claim -
> for cruise lines, shipping companies and offshore operators across India,
> Singapore and the UAE.

MedShield sits between the vessel and the shore: an independent medical team
above a verified provider network. Because the medical judgement is our own
and not the treating facility's, hospital selection, treatment plans and
invoices are reviewed by clinicians who have no financial relationship with
the provider. That independence is the core of the offering.

Operating footprint: 45+ locations across India, offices in Singapore and the
UAE, and a partner network of 1,800+ hospitals, clinics, labs, pharmacies and
rehabilitation providers. Telemedicine reaches crew wherever the vessel is, so
a case can begin at sea and be handed to a treating facility on arrival.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://medshield.in/services.html): All six service lines in detail, plus the eight-step case process.
- Claims management: The case is run end to end - one dedicated case manager, one point of contact, from first call to closed claim.
- Claims advisory & legal: Advisory and legal support on disputed, complex or high-value claims.
- Medical welfare budgeting: Forecasting and controlling crew medical spend across a fleet.
- Telemedicine: Care that starts at sea, regardless of the vessel's position.
- Fraud prevention and cost safeguards: Independent review of hospital pricing and referral patterns to catch inflated invoices and financially-motivated referrals.
- Occupational health & safety, and medico-legal services: OHS programmes and medico-legal casework.
